$comment: Licence policy for shipped artefacts (STACK-04; ADR 0009, ADR 0011). Enforced by tools/ci/check_licences.py on the CycloneDX SBOMs from tools/sbom.sh. Licence ids are SPDX and compared case-insensitively; patterns use shell globs. A licence that matches nothing is unknown and denied. Every exception needs component, licence, reason, approver and expires (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired exception is ignored, and one expiring within 30 days passes with a warning.

system_packages.$comment: Applies only in SBOMs matching `sboms` (container images), to components that are not our language dependencies: OS packages (deb/apk/rpm/alpm), binaries without a package URL or with pkg:generic, and crates/modules compiled into third-party binaries (cargo/golang, e.g. uv in the migrator image; syft reads no licence for them). Base-distribution packages such as bash or glibc are GPL/LGPL, shipped unmodified and not linked into our code, so here only AGPL, SSPL (in any spelling; patterns match case-insensitively) and the named packages are denied (ADR 0011). deny_names applies to every component in every SBOM.
